name: Johanan
overview: Johanan was a male member of the tribe of Levi, distinguished as an Aaronic priest through the lineage of Eleazar. He is uniquely identified as the son of Azariah_6 and the father of Azariah_1, situating him within a significant priestly family line. His role within the Levitical priesthood highlights his importance in maintaining the religious heritage of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Johanan means 'y-h-v-h is gracious,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning grounded in the graciousness of God. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 6:9, does not indicate that it was given directly by God but carries the significance of divine grace.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Johanan as the son of Azariah_6 and the father of Azariah_1, establishing a direct paternal lineage that underscores his place within the priestly family. These relationships are explicitly noted in 1 Chronicles 6:9-10, affirming his genealogical context within the tribe of Levi.
scriptureSignificance: Johanan's significance lies in his role as an Aaronic priest descended through Eleazar, which situates him within the sacred priestly tradition responsible for temple service and worship. His genealogical placement in 1 Chronicles highlights the continuity of priestly duties and the preservation of the covenantal priesthood. Through his lineage, the faithful witness the transmission of God-ordained religious responsibilities across generations.
